overview:
Atheneum is a global insights platform founded in 2010 in Berlin, Germany, by former management consultants Ammad Ahmad, Mathias Wengeler, and serial entrepreneur Michael Brehm. The company operates as a Research-as-a-Service (RaaS) provider, connecting leading investment funds, strategy consulting firms, and corporations with a curated network of over one million industry experts worldwide. With European roots and a strong initial presence in Germany, Atheneum has expanded to 11+ offices across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, with U.S. headquarters in New York.

Atheneum differentiates itself through its proprietary technology stack, including the machine-learning-powered Athena One cloud platform and the newer AI-powered ATLAS platform, which automate expert matching, enable real-time availability tracking, and streamline the entire research lifecycle. Through a strategic partnership with Nikkei Inc., Atheneum co-launched NIKKEI SEEKS, providing access to 500,000+ Japan-based experts for cross-border research.

In 2021, Atheneum secured $150 million in growth equity funding led by Guidepost Growth Equity, valuing the company at approximately $300 million. The company reports revenue of approximately $95 million and serves around 500 large enterprise clients. In 2024, Jim Owens was appointed CEO succeeding co-founder Mathias Wengeler, and Mark Gerson was named CTO to lead AI platform development.

history.narrative: Atheneum was born from a gap identified by co-founders Ammad Ahmad and Mathias Wengeler, both former management consultants who recognized that the professional services industry needed a faster, more technology-enabled way to access expert insights. Michael Brehm, a serial entrepreneur and founder of Redstone VC, joined as co-founder and investor. The company launched in Berlin in 2010 and built a strong regional presence in Germany and Central Europe before expanding globally. The 2021 $150M growth equity round from Guidepost Growth Equity was transformational, enabling heavy investment in technology, geographic expansion, and talent. Co-founder Wengeler served as CEO until 2024, when Jim Owens took over leadership.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one or group consultations connecting clients with pre-screened industry experts. Atheneum delivers preliminary expert shortlists within 30–60 minutes of request, with full screening and vetting. Available in 40+ languages with simultaneous translation support.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Quantitative research through custom-recruited expert panels. Surveys can be deployed within 24 hours, gathering thousands of data points with stringent validation. Designed for private equity due diligence, market sizing, and trend analysis.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert-Backed Research
servicesDetailed.description: Full-service custom research leveraging Atheneum's in-house team to moderate interviews, produce transcripts, recordings, and white-label reports. Includes voice-of-customer studies, model assessments, and target screenings delivered in multiple languages.

servicesDetailed.name: In-Person Meetings & Workshops
servicesDetailed.description: Facilitated face-to-face engagements connecting clients directly with subject matter experts for deeper qualitative research and strategic insight sessions.

servicesDetailed.name: Long-Term Expert Placements
servicesDetailed.description: Custom recruitment of experts for extended consulting engagements, providing clients with ongoing access to specialized industry knowledge beyond one-off calls.

servicesDetailed.name: NIKKEI SEEKS (Japan Insights)
servicesDetailed.description: Co-branded global insights hub developed in partnership with Nikkei Inc., providing access to 500,000+ Japan-based experts for cross-border research, combining Atheneum's RaaS model with Nikkei's domestic expert platform.

aiPlatform.narrative: Atheneum has invested heavily in proprietary technology to differentiate from traditional expert networks. Its cloud-based Athena One platform uses machine learning to automate expert matching, project management, and insight delivery. In 2024, newly appointed CTO Mark Gerson — previously co-founder of Chime Advisors, a machine-driven expert network — began leading development of the next-generation ATLAS platform, further integrating AI into expert recruitment and matching. The Atheneum Hub mobile app enables experts to manage opportunities, schedules, and payments, with 33% faster onboarding than web registration.

complianceExtended.narrative: As a German-headquartered company, Atheneum operates under the strict data protection requirements of the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and has built its compliance infrastructure accordingly. The company maintains a formal Data Protection Officer reporting directly to the COO, as well as a dedicated Privacy Chief. Atheneum acts as a data controller under GDPR and adheres to data minimization and storage limitation principles. Client access to expert information is strictly controlled — during selection, clients only receive overviews of professional experience, with no personal data shared without explicit consent. The company also complies with China's PIPL, reflecting its growing Asia-Pacific presence.

clientFit.narrative: Atheneum serves approximately 500 large enterprises across four primary segments. The Research-as-a-Service model and survey capabilities are especially valuable for private equity due diligence and consulting firms seeking rapid expert access.
